upgrade_description: Upgrade projects/PeelAndSlice.Java from Java 17 to Java 21 on branch upgrade/java-21, preserving behavior. Replace Maven compiler source/target 17 with release 21, pin maven-compiler-plugin 3.16.0, declare UTF-8 source encoding, update the CI Java matrix to 21, retain the existing test outcome, and produce class-file major version 65.

ordered_changes.rationale: The POM is the single compilation boundary for all production and test sources. It must make Java 21 bytecode/API targeting deterministic, pin the compiler implementation, and decode the existing Cyrillic source and identifiers consistently on Windows and Linux.

locations.symbol_or_pattern: project metadata and XML encoding declaration

ordered_changes.change_description: Add a project-level <properties> block after the coordinates containing <project.build.sourceEncoding>UTF-8</project.build.sourceEncoding>. In the existing maven-compiler-plugin declaration, add <version>3.16.0</version>. Replace the separate <source>17</source> and <target>17</target> configuration elements with the single <release>21</release> element. Do not alter dependencies, Surefire configuration, Java sources, or test behavior.
validation_evidence: pom.xml literally declares project.build.sourceEncoding as UTF-8.
pom.xml pins maven-compiler-plugin to 3.16.0 and configures release 21, with the former source/target 17 elements absent.
mvn -B clean verify --file pom.xml completes with the same test pass/fail counts as the pre-upgrade baseline and requires no extra flags.

ordered_changes.rationale: The workflow matrix selects the JDK consumed by actions/setup-java and the Maven verification step, so it must follow the new Java 21 compilation contract.
ordered_changes.change_description: Change only the build job's Java matrix literal from java: ['17'] to java: ['21']. Keep setup-java wired to matrix.java, retain the Ubuntu runner and existing Maven command, and make no unrelated workflow changes.
validation_evidence: .github/workflows/test.yml literally contains java: ['21'] and no longer contains java: ['17'].
The existing Ubuntu build job continues to pass matrix.java to actions/setup-java and then runs Maven verification, providing Linux coverage with JDK 21 when CI executes.

success_criteria: Only pom.xml and .github/workflows/test.yml contain planned upgrade edits; no Java source, dependency, or unrelated behavior changes are introduced.
mvn -B clean verify --file pom.xml passes under JDK 21 on Windows with no extra flags and preserves the pre-upgrade test pass/fail counts.
The unchanged ubuntu-latest workflow uses JDK 21 and passes mvn -B verify --file pom.xml when CI runs, supplying Linux validation with no extra Maven flags.
The representative compiled class target/classes/com/spun/llewellyn/talks/legacycode/required/VideoMaker.class reports major version 65.
The POM pins maven-compiler-plugin 3.16.0, uses release 21 rather than source/target 17, and declares UTF-8 project source encoding.
The CI Java matrix contains only Java 21.

rollback_strategy: Revert the single final execution commit created by the executor.
planning_notes: Inspection was limited to the ImpactReport ranges plus minimal context (pom.xml lines 1-23 and .github/workflows/test.yml lines 11-33); no whole target file was read. The user supplied mvn -B clean verify --file pom.xml for both compile and test validation, so it appears in executor and final build/test validation. There is no startup target, browser flow, external service, database, or search index. The requested class-major check was made executable by selecting the stable production class VideoMaker.class and invoking javap -verbose; validation must positively confirm 'major version: 65', not merely the absence of version 61. The approved workflow currently runs ubuntu-latest only, and the requested workflow change is specifically java ['17'] to ['21']; therefore this plan does not silently broaden scope by adding a Windows runner. Windows validation is performed locally by the executor/validator, while Linux validation remains dependent on the existing GitHub Actions Ubuntu job running after push. If that CI job cannot be observed, Linux is an explicit unresolved platform-validation gap rather than an inferred pass. The same-test-count requirement needs a trustworthy pre-upgrade baseline captured before edits (or an existing approved baseline); stale target/Surefire output is not accepted as evidence. A bounded scope-expansion allowance of two files permits only direct Java 21 or maven-compiler-plugin 3.16.0 compatibility failures discovered by the declared verification command; it does not authorize unrelated fixes, refactors, dependency changes, or workflow expansion.
plan_summary: Two-file Java 21 upgrade: make Maven compilation deterministic with release 21, compiler plugin 3.16.0, and UTF-8 encoding, then move the existing CI JDK matrix to 21. Validate with clean Maven verification, preserved test counts, and a major-version-65 class inspection; Windows is locally testable and Linux remains the existing Ubuntu CI responsibility.
